candidates.name: Mercadolibre Inc
candidates.description: Both operate diversified ecosystems combining e-commerce and fintech payments in emerging markets.
candidates.rationale: Same diversified consumer internet model: e-commerce plus fintech payments in emerging markets; clear peer to Sea/Shopee.

candidates.name: Coupang Corp.
candidates.description: Both are large-scale e-commerce operators focused on high-growth Asian markets.
candidates.rationale: Both are large consumer internet e-commerce platforms serving high-growth Asian markets with similar marketplace customer bases.

candidates.name: Bukalapak
candidates.description: Both provide e-commerce platforms specifically targeting the Indonesian digital economy.
candidates.rationale: Indonesian e-commerce platform like Shopee; similar consumer internet business model and buyer base.

candidates.name: Grab
candidates.description: Both are Southeast Asian super-apps integrating delivery, e-commerce, and financial services.
candidates.rationale: Both are Southeast Asian consumer internet super-apps with e-commerce, delivery, and financial services, targeting similar users and merchants.

candidates.name: Tencent
candidates.description: Both operate diversified conglomerates spanning digital entertainment, gaming, and fintech.
candidates.rationale: Tencent is a much larger diversified tech conglomerate, not a comparable e-commerce-led Southeast Asian consumer internet peer.

candidates.name: Flipkart Group
candidates.description: Both operate dominant regional e-commerce marketplaces for diverse consumer goods.
candidates.rationale: Both are large regional consumer e-commerce marketplace operators serving similar buyer and seller ecosystems.

candidates.name: NetEase, Inc.
candidates.description: Both are major internet technology firms with significant footprints in digital gaming and entertainment.
candidates.rationale: Different core businesses and customer bases: Sea is Southeast Asian e-commerce/fintech; NetEase is primarily a gaming and internet services company.

candidates.name: Jumia Technologies AG
candidates.description: Both lead e-commerce platforms in emerging regions characterized by rapid digitalization.
candidates.rationale: Both are consumer internet e-commerce platforms serving emerging markets; comparable model and buyer/customer overlap.

candidates.name: Daraz Group
candidates.description: Both are major e-commerce platforms serving the South and Southeast Asian consumer markets.
candidates.rationale: Major consumer e-commerce platform in similar Asian markets with overlapping marketplace model and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Alibaba
candidates.description: Both operate massive ecosystem plays combining e-commerce, cloud, and digital payments.
candidates.rationale: Both are large consumer internet platforms with overlapping e-commerce and digital payments businesses serving similar merchant and shopper audiences.

candidates.name: Meituan.com
candidates.description: Both provide a wide array of digital lifestyle and commerce services via a single platform.
candidates.rationale: Different primary markets and regional focus; Meituan is China-centric local services, while Sea is Southeast Asia e-commerce, gaming, and fintech.

candidates.name: Naver Corp
candidates.description: Both are large-scale ICT companies managing diverse digital platforms and consumer services.
candidates.rationale: Different core businesses and regions; Naver is a Korean platform company, not a Southeast Asian e-commerce/fintech lookalike.

candidates.name: Yandex
candidates.description: Both function as regional tech giants providing a suite of search, commerce, and digital tools.
candidates.rationale: Different regions and core businesses; Yandex is a Russian tech/platform company, not a Southeast Asian consumer internet lookalike for Sea.

candidates.name: EA
candidates.description: Both are major players in the digital entertainment and video game publishing sector.
candidates.rationale: EA is a video game publisher, not a Southeast Asian consumer internet/e-commerce/fintech company like Sea.

candidates.name: Tiki Corporation
candidates.description: Both operate e-commerce platforms serving the Vietnamese consumer market.
candidates.rationale: Vietnamese consumer e-commerce platform similar to Shopee’s marketplace model and buyer base.

candidates.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
candidates.description: Both are global leaders in e-commerce and cloud computing infrastructure.
candidates.rationale: Amazon is a much larger global retailer/cloud provider, not a comparable Southeast Asian consumer internet peer to Sea.

candidates.name: Alibaba
candidates.description: Both facilitate large-scale digital trade and connect buyers with suppliers online.
candidates.rationale: Both are large-scale consumer internet/e-commerce platforms connecting buyers and sellers online, with overlapping merchant and consumer audiences.

candidates.name: Paytm
candidates.description: Both operate integrated digital payment and financial service platforms.
candidates.rationale: Different core business: Sea is e-commerce plus entertainment; Paytm is primarily payments/financial services, not a direct lookalike.

candidates.name: Kaspi
candidates.description: Both drive user engagement through an integrated ecosystem of payments, marketplace, and services.
candidates.rationale: Similar consumer internet ecosystem with marketplace, payments, and services; comparable buyer and product motions.

candidates.name: Krafton
candidates.description: Both are heavily invested in the development and operation of high-revenue digital games.
candidates.rationale: Different businesses: Sea is consumer internet/e-commerce and fintech; Krafton is a game publisher, not a comparable sales prospect.
